files.content: # Pixel RPG — Style Prompt > A story told the way a mid-90s console role-playing game tells it: a 320×180 pixel screen scaled ×6 with no smoothing, a small world shaded by ordered dither, text boxes that type with a talking portrait, status windows, menus with a hand cursor and save-slot lists. Colour changes in whole steps, never by alpha. ## 1. Essence, and what it is not - **320×180 native pixels**, shown at ×6 nearest-neighbour in 1920×1080. Everything, text included, sits on that grid; the camera moves in whole pixels. - **A limited palette.** Gradients are 4×4 Bayer dither between two or three tones, never a smooth blend. - **Small sprites** (about 28 px tall) that act in a handful of frames, and **portraits** (24×24) that carry the face. - **The interface is the narration**: dialog boxes, a stat window, a quest list, a save-slot list, a progress bar, a "slot saved" window. - A hero mark that survives every scene (a headband tail in the brand colour) and a protected glowing crystal as the thread of the story. Not HD-2D (no depth of field, bloom, real-time light), not CRT nostalgia (no scanlines or grain), not a parody. The game's systems are used seriously as a language for feeling and progress. ## 2. Materials & rendering - **Framebuffer drawing.** World layers, sprites, portraits and thumbnails are painted once at load into small buffers (a seeded PRNG, `putImageData`), turned into `` and then only moved. Nothing is redrawn per frame. - **World**: a far layer (dithered dawn sky, a crescent moon, hills, round-canopy trees, diagonal light shafts as a flat 50 % checker with a 25 % edge) panning at about 0.4×, and a near layer (track, lamps, bench, a finish arch, a crystal on a pedestal) at 1×. Lamp glows and the crystal glow are Bayer-thresholded rings. - **Sprites from a rig**: blocks for torso, limbs and head with three tones lit from the upper left, a 1-px ink outline over everything, a headband tail as the silhouette mark. Four run frames plus one stand frame, stepped at 8 fps. - **Portrait**: 24×24, base face plus two mouth states that alternate while the text types. - **Windows**: a 1-px silver border inside a 1-px white line inside a 1-px ink line, filled in three hard bands (no smooth gradient). Text has a 1-px shadow. - **Transitions**: a mosaic dither of 25/50/75/100 % ink coverage stepped in and out (about 0.07 s per step), with the scene swap at full coverage. ## 3. Colour logic - **Palette = feeling.** The world is mixed from tokens: `--latar` and `--latar-2` form the ramp (ink, night, dusk), `--teks` the light end, `--utama` and `--aksen` the dawn glow. - **`--utama`** is the hero's headband and the filled stamina bar; **`--aksen`** is the protected crystal, light shafts and the second bar (use sparingly). Words that need colour on a window use `--utama-di-latar`. - **Fixed**: skin tones. Everything else, including the ink outline, follows the brand. - Window fills are `--latar-2` with a slight `--aksen` tint on the top band; text on them is `--teks` or `--teks-redup`. - Under a pale brand the same logic yields a daylight world with dark ink and light windows; never switch palettes by alpha. ## 4. Type - `--font-judul` and `--font-isi` are both **Press Start 2P**: 8 px (48 px on screen) for windows and dialog, 16 px (96 px) for the title with an 8-neighbour ink outline. The font is monospace, so typing is a stepped clip with one step per character. - Dialog lines are at most 30 characters, two lines per box; menu and status labels are short capitals (5–13 characters). Leave room if a brand's font is wider. - Typing speed 36–44 characters per second; a ▼ arrow appears when the line ends. Every box stays at least 1.8 s. ## 5. Motion quality - Sprites step at **8 fps** (run) and **12 fps** (talk); the crystal bobs 2 px every 0.5 s on a step ease. - Camera and parallax use snapped integer-pixel positions with a `power2.out` slow-down over 3.1 s; the far layer moves at 0.4×. - Windows slide in over 0.3 s with `steps(6)` (whole pixels); the hand cursor jumps one row at a time, 0.5 s per beat. Bars rise in 4 steps over 0.25 s; numbers swap instantly. - A level-up hop: the hero rises 8 px in 4 steps and back; stars flicker on 0.17 s steps. - Scene cut: eight dither steps of 0.07 s each; the new scene appears at 0.25 s. - The final 2 s are still except the crystal's bob. ## 6. Camera grammar | Move | What it expresses | Can serve | |---|---|---| | Side-scroll with parallax layers | journey, progress | a training plan, a commute, a timeline | | Locked frame with UI on one third | a system speaking, a choice | a stats reveal, a class menu | | Palette step fade (dither mosaic) | a new chapter | scene changes, a time skip | | Hold on a dimmed world under windows | focus on information | a quest list, a price list | | Hero beside the goal | arrival | a finish line, a launch, a signup | | Hop with sparkles | reward | a level, a milestone, a discount unlocked | Framing: characters stay above the dialog box (the floor line is above its top edge); windows leave the action visible. ## 7. Native moves - **Typing dialog box.** A portrait talks, text arrives one character at a time, the arrow blinks at the end. *Fits content like:* a coach's greeting, a shop owner's promise, a teacher's first line, a narrator in a story. - **Level up.** A stat window with bars that step up and a number that counts, then a message window with stars. *Fits content like:* a 30-day challenge, a student's first week, a loyalty tier, a skill learned. - **Quest list with hand cursor.** One row per beat, each lighting up when done. *Fits content like:* a course syllabus, a repair checklist, a trip itinerary, a recipe in steps. - **Save-slot list.** Slots with tiny thumbnails; the cursor chooses one. *Fits content like:* class schedules, price tiers, chapters of a career, versions of a product. - **Press-and-save.** A menu is pressed, a bar fills in steps, a "saved" window sparkles. *Fits content like:* signup, booking, a pre-order, a reservation. - **Protected-colour thread.** One colour (the crystal) is the same everywhere. *Fits content like:* a brand mark across scenes, a trophy, a goal in a story. ## 8. Pitfalls - Smooth gradients, blur, fractional scaling of sprites or text: everything must stay on the pixel grid. - Alpha fades between scenes: use the dither mosaic. - Long text: more than 30 characters per line overflows the box. - Hero marks drawn too small to read at ×6: keep the headband tail at least 4 px. - A dialog box covering the hero: the floor line stays above y=134. - Redrawing the full-size canvas each frame: paint once, then move images. - Pale brands: check that window text, the title outline and the hand cursor still read.

# Pixel RPG: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.6, long 3.4.

## hook

- en: a side-scrolling pixel world in whole-pixel steps, an outlined title, a small hero running to a crystal; a dialog box types the first line
- id: dunia piksel bergulir per piksel utuh, judul berkontur, pahlawan kecil berlari ke kristal; kotak dialog mengetik kalimat pertama

## problem

- en: the world drops to a dimmed palette and a top message window types the obstacle, the hand cursor hesitating on one menu row
- id: dunia meredup lewat palet, jendela pesan di atas mengetik rintangannya, kursor tangan ragu di satu baris menu

## fact

- en: a stat window slides in and its bars step up in four jumps while the value text swaps; the portrait talks in a dialog box
- id: jendela statistik masuk, bilahnya naik empat lompatan sambil angka berganti; potret bicara di kotak dialog

## step

- en: a quest list, the hand cursor moves one row per beat, each row lights up, LV and bars rise with it, a level-up window sparkles
- id: daftar misi, kursor tangan turun satu baris per ketukan, tiap baris menyala, LV dan bilah naik, jendela naik level berkilau

## compare

- en: a save-file list: two or three slots side by side with tiny thumbnails; the cursor jumps between them, the chosen label lights up
- id: daftar slot simpan: dua atau tiga slot dengan gambar kecil; kursor melompat antar slot, label terpilih menyala

## number

- en: one stat window alone: the number swaps in whole steps (0 to 5) while its bar fills, then a short fanfare of sparkles
- id: satu jendela statistik sendirian: angka berganti per langkah (0 ke 5) sambil bilahnya terisi, lalu kilau singkat

## proof

- en: a character dialog with the portrait talking: one line of praise or result typed at 36 characters per second, held until the arrow shows
- id: dialog tokoh dengan potret bicara: satu kalimat pujian atau hasil diketik 36 huruf per detik, ditahan sampai panah muncul

## offer

- en: a menu of options as a save-file list; the hand cursor walks the rows, the choice is highlighted in the main colour and confirmed
- id: menu pilihan berupa daftar slot simpan; kursor tangan menyusuri baris, pilihan disorot warna utama lalu dikonfirmasi

## cta

- en: a DAFTAR-style menu is pressed, a progress bar fills in steps, a SAVE COMPLETE window sparkles; contact typed in the dialog; held 2 s
- id: menu DAFTAR ditekan, bilah mengisi per langkah, jendela slot dipesan berkilau; kontak diketik di dialog; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the hero stands at the crystal, a final dialog line types and the arrow blinks; the world sits still, palette unchanged; held 2 s
- id: pahlawan berdiri di kristal, satu kalimat penutup diketik dan panah muncul; dunia diam, palet tetap; diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Misi lari 5 km</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Press Start 2P"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #181425; --latar-2: #262b44; --utama: #e43b44; --aksen: #2ce8f5;
        --teks: #ffffff; --teks-redup: #8b9bb4; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff; --teks-di-aksen: #181425;
        --utama-di-latar: #f6757a; --aksen-di-latar: #2ce8f5;
        --font-judul: "Press Start 2P", "Noto Sans", monospace; --font-isi: "Press Start 2P", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        /* Dicampur dari token: tinta kontur, bayangan teks, tiga pita isi jendela. */
        --tinta: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 45%, black); --bayang: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2) 40%, black);
        --w1: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2) 86%, var(--aksen)); --w2: var(--latar-2); --w3: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2) 55%, var(--latar));
        /* Warna kulit tetap di semua brand. */
        --kulit: #e8b796; --kulit-bayang: #c28569;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      /* Layar 320x180 piksel game, diperbesar 6x tanpa haluskan. Semua satuan di dalamnya piksel game. */
      .scr { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 320px; height: 180px; transform: scale(6); transform-origin: 0 0; overflow: hidden; font: 8px/1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--teks); }
      .scr img { position: absolute; display: block; image-rendering: pixelated; }
      .hid { visibility: hidden; }
      .box { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 180px; }
      #fb { width: 480px; } #nb { width: 640px; }
      #xt { position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 20px; z-index: 2; }
      #run { position: absolute; left: 80px; top: 99px; width: 18px; height: 28px; overflow: hidden; }
      #dim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--latar); opacity: 0; }
      .t { position: absolute; white-space: pre; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--bayang); }
      .k { color: var(--utama-di-latar); } .r { color: var(--teks-redup); }
      /* Jendela: tepi tinta, putih, perak; isi tiga pita keras (tanpa gradasi halus). */
      .win { position: absolute; border: 1px solid var(--teks-redup); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--teks), 0 0 0 2px var(--tinta); background: linear-gradient(var(--w1) 0 25%, var(--w2) 25% 75%, var(--w3) 75%); }
      .dlg { left: 8px; top: 134px; width: 304px; height: 42px; }
      .por { position: absolute; left: 5px; top: 8px; width: 24px; height: 24px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--tinta); }
      .ln { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); }
      .arr { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 6px; border: 3px solid transparent; border-top: 4px solid var(--teks); border-bottom: 0; visibility: hidden; }
      #ttl .t { text-shadow: 1px 0 var(--tinta), -1px 0 var(--tinta), 0 1px var(--tinta), 0 -1px var(--tinta), 1px 1px var(--tinta), -1px -1px var(--tinta), 1px -1px var(--tinta), -1px 1px var(--tinta); }
      .big { font: 16px/1 var(--font-judul); }
      .bar { position: absolute; width: 92px; height: 4px; background: var(--bayang); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--tinta); }
      .bar b { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 0 0; transform: scaleX(0.1); background: linear-gradient(var(--utama) 0 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 62%, black) 50%); }
      .bar.a b { background: linear-gradient(var(--aksen) 0 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 62%, black) 50%); }
      .vak { position: absolute; width: 42px; height: 24px; border: 1px dashed var(--teks-redup); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Dunia: langit, bukit, pohon (jauh, geser pelan) dan jalur, lampu, gerbang (dekat, geser penuh). -->
      <div class="scr" id="wd">
        <div class="box" id="fb"></div>
        <div class="box" id="nb"><div id="xt" style="left: 392px; top: 90px"></div></div>
        <div id="run"></div>
        <div id="dim"></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: judul bermain di atas jalur subuh, pelari menuju kristal, kotak dialog mengetik. -->
      <div class="scr" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div id="ttl"><div class="t big" style="left: 88px; top: 12px">MISI 5 KM</div><div class="t" style="left: 76px; top: 34px">LARI SUBUH TAMAN KOTA</div></div>
        <div class="win dlg" id="d1"><div class="por"></div><span class="t ln" style="left: 42px; top: 10px">Belum pernah lari?</span><span class="t ln" style="left: 42px; top: 23px">Mulai dari satu kilometer.</span><i class="arr"></i></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 2, langkah: status pelari naik level, kursor tangan menandai misi mingguan satu per satu. -->
      <div class="scr hid" id="s2" data-role="step">
        <div class="win" id="st" style="left: 4px; top: 4px; width: 150px; height: 60px">
          <span class="t" style="left: 8px; top: 7px">PELARI</span><span class="t r" style="left: 66px; top: 7px">LV</span>
          <span class="t" style="left: 8px; top: 22px">KAKI</span><span class="t" style="left: 8px; top: 34px">TEKAD</span>
          <div class="bar" style="left: 54px; top: 23px"><b id="b1"></b></div><div class="bar a" style="left: 54px; top: 35px"><b id="b2"></b></div>
          <span class="t" style="left: 8px; top: 47px">JARAK</span>
        </div>
        <div class="win" id="qs" style="left: 164px; top: 4px; width: 152px; height: 66px"><span class="t k" style="left: 8px; top: 6px">MISI MINGGU</span></div>
        <div class="win hid" id="lvm" style="left: 84px; top: 84px; width: 152px; height: 20px"><span class="t ln" style="left: 12px; top: 6px">NAIK LEVEL! 5 KM</span></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 3, tawaran: daftar berkas ala slot simpan; tiap kelas punya gambar kecil, kursor memilih satu. -->
      <div class="scr hid" id="s3" data-role="offer">
        <div class="win" id="fl" style="left: 4px; top: 4px; width: 200px; height: 124px"><span class="t k" style="left: 20px; top: 6px">PILIH KELAS</span><div class="vak" style="left: 19px; top: 93px"></div><span class="t r" style="left: 68px; top: 101px">KAMU DI SINI?</span></div>
        <div class="win dlg" id="d3"><div class="por"></div><span class="t ln" style="left: 42px; top: 10px">Minggu pertama gratis.</span><span class="t ln" style="left: 42px; top: 23px">Pilih jam, kami temani.</span><i class="arr"></i></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 4, ajakan: menu DAFTAR ditekan, bilah menyimpan terisi, SLOT DIPESAN; kontak di kotak dialog, diam 2 detik. -->
      <div class="scr hid" id="s4" data-role="cta">
        <div class="win" id="sv" style="left: 236px; top: 14px; width: 76px; height: 34px"><span class="t" id="sv1" style="left: 20px; top: 8px">DAFTAR</span><span class="t r" style="left: 20px; top: 20px">NANTI</span></div>
        <div class="win hid" id="sg" style="left: 180px; top: 70px; width: 132px; height: 30px"><span class="t" style="left: 10px; top: 6px">MENDAFTAR...</span><div class="bar" style="left: 10px; top: 19px; width: 110px"><b id="b3"></b></div></div>
        <div class="win hid" id="sc" style="left: 180px; top: 70px; width: 132px; height: 30px"><span class="t k" style="left: 14px; top: 11px">SLOT DIPESAN!</span></div>
        <div class="win dlg" id="d4"><div class="por"></div><span class="t ln" style="left: 42px; top: 10px">Kelas subuh sisa 12 kursi.</span><span class="t ln" style="left: 42px; top: 23px">Chat 0812-3456-7890</span><i class="arr"></i></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Lapisan transisi: mosaik dither 25/50/75/100 persen, bukan fade alfa. -->
      <div class="scr" id="dz"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s), mk = (t) => document.createElement(t), { sin, floor, round, min, max, sqrt, ceil } = Math;
      const lerp = (a, b, u) => a + (b - a) * u, ss = (u) => u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
      // PRNG berbiji dan derau 1D: sama di pratinjau dan render.
      const RNG = (seed) => { let s = (seed * 2654435761) >>> 0 || 1; return () => { s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0; let t = s; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; };
      const nz = (x, s = 0) => { const h = (i) => { const n = sin(i * 127.1 + s * 311.7) * 43758.5453; return n - floor(n); }, i = floor(x); return lerp(h(i), h(i + 1), ss(x - i)); };
      // Token menjadi [r,g,b]; semua warna dunia dicampur dari token, jadi brand ikut.
      const uji = document.body.appendChild(mk("i")), px = mk("canvas").getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
      const C = (n) => { uji.style.color = `var(--${n})`; px.clearRect(0, 0, 2, 2); px.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(uji).color; px.fillRect(0, 0, 1, 1); return [...px.getImageData(0, 0, 1, 1).data.slice(0, 3)]; };
      const mx = (a, b, t) => a.map((v, i) => round(v + (b[i] - v) * t));
      const L = C("latar"), L2 = C("latar-2"), T = C("teks"), U = C("utama"), A = C("aksen"), K = C("tinta"), SK = C("kulit"), SK2 = C("kulit-bayang");
      // Dither 4x4 Bayer: gradasi hanya dari pola ini, tidak pernah dicampur halus.
      const BY = [0, 8, 2, 10, 12, 4, 14, 6, 3, 11, 1, 9, 15, 7, 13, 5].map((v) => (v + 0.5) / 16), bay = (x, y) => BY[(y & 3) * 4 + (x & 3)];

      // ===== 1. Framebuffer piksel (port px.js): P titik, R kotak, O kontur 1 piksel, G baca =====
      const Fb = (w, h) => {
        const cv = mk("canvas"), cx = cv.getContext("2d"); cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
        const d = cx.createImageData(w, h), b = d.data; let u = "";
        const P = (x, y, c, a = 255) => { x = floor(x); y = floor(y); if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= w || y >= h || !c) return; const i = (y * w + x) * 4; b[i] = c[0]; b[i + 1] = c[1]; b[i + 2] = c[2]; b[i + 3] = a; };
        const G = (x, y) => { const i = (y * w + x) * 4; return b[i + 3] ? [b[i], b[i + 1], b[i + 2]] : null; };
        const R = (x, y, rw, rh, c) => { for (let j = 0; j < rh; j++) for (let i = 0; i < rw; i++) P(x + i, y + j, c); };
        const O = (c) => {
          const m = [], has = (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < w && y < h && b[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3];
          for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (!has(x, y) && (has(x + 1, y) || has(x - 1, y) || has(x, y + 1) || has(x, y - 1))) m.push([x, y]);
          m.forEach(([x, y]) => P(x, y, c));
        };
        const png = () => u || (cx.putImageData(d, 0, 0), (u = cv["toDataURL"]("image/png")));
        return { w, h, P, G, R, O, png, b };
      };
      const disc = (b, cx, cy, r, f) => { for (let y = -r; y <= r; y++) for (let x = -r; x <= r; x++) if (x * x + y * y <= r * r + r) f(cx + x, cy + y, x, y); };
      const put = (fb, par, x, y) => { const e = Object.assign(new Image(), { src: fb.png() }); Object.assign(e.style, { left: x + "px", top: y + "px", width: fb.w + "px", height: fb.h + "px" }); par.appendChild(e); return e; };
      const spr = (rows, pal) => { const b = Fb(rows[0].length, rows.length); rows.forEach((s, y) => [...s].forEach((ch, x) => b.P(x, y, pal[ch]))); return b; };

      // ===== 2. Dunia: langit dither, bukit, pohon, berkas cahaya kotak-kotak =====
      function farLayer() {
        const b = Fb(480, 180), r = RNG(7), sky = [mx(L, K, 0.3), L, mx(L, L2, 0.6), mx(L2, A, 0.14), mx(L2, U, 0.18)];
        const skyC = (x, y) => { const t = (min(y, 121) / 122) * 4, i = min(3, floor(t)); return bay(x, y) < t - i ? sky[i + 1] : sky[i]; };
        for (let y = 0; y < 180; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 480; x++) b.P(x, y, skyC(x, y));
        for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) b.P(r() * 480, r() * 52, mx(T, L, 0.2));
        disc(b, 300, 26, 6, (x, y) => b.P(x, y, mx(T, L2, 0.1))); disc(b, 303, 24, 5, (x, y) => b.P(x, y, skyC(x, y)));
        for (let x = 0; x < 480; x++) {
          const h1 = floor(98 - 14 * nz(x / 60, 1)), h2 = floor(108 - 9 * nz(x / 34, 2));
          b.R(x, h1, 1, 40, mx(L, L2, 0.3)); b.R(x, h2, 1, 30, mx(L, K, 0.35)); b.P(x, h2, mx(L, L2, 0.55));
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 17; i++) {
          const x = 10 + i * 28 + floor(r() * 12), rr = 7 + floor(r() * 5), cy = 112 - rr - floor(r() * 6);
          b.R(x - 1, cy, 2, 122 - cy, mx(L, K, 0.5));
          disc(b, x, cy, rr, (a, c, dx, dy) => b.P(a, c, dx + dy < -rr * 0.5 && bay(a, c) < 0.6 ? mx(L, L2, 0.5) : mx(L, K, 0.5)));
        }
        b.R(0, 121, 480, 59, mx(L, L2, 0.3));
        // Berkas cahaya: kotak-kotak 50 persen, tepinya 25 persen.
